task_description: Build TrustMark - a PWA web app on Google Apps Script for adding timemark/timestamp overlays to photos with EXIF metadata manipulation, map-based location selection, QRIS payment integration, and professional overlay rendering. All client-side processing with localStorage persistence.

verification.summary: All files validated. Code.gs has proper GAS functions. manifest.json is valid JSON with corrected start_url. sw.js has all required event handlers. index.html (50.6KB) passes JS syntax validation and contains all required modules with review fixes applied: canvas overflow fixed, GAS paths corrected, EXIF encoding fixed, rendering deduplicated, localStorage protected, QRIS tag insertion hardened.
